instruction: I cannot connect to the office VPN.
response: 1. Check that your internet connection works. 2. Confirm you are using the organization's approved VPN client and server address. 3. Restart the VPN client and retry. 4. If the error continues, note the exact error message without sharing passwords or verification codes and contact IT.

instruction: My Windows computer has no sound.
response: 1. Check the volume and mute status. 2. Open Sound settings and confirm the intended output device is selected. 3. Disconnect and reconnect the headset or speakers. 4. Contact IT before installing drivers or changing administrator settings on a managed work device.

instruction: Microsoft Teams is not syncing messages.
response: 1. Check whether other websites and services are reachable. 2. Confirm Teams is updated and restart the app. 3. If permitted by your organization's policy, sign out and back in. 4. Record the approximate time and any error text and contact IT. Never share your password or MFA code.

instruction: My laptop cannot connect to Wi-Fi.
response: 1. Check whether Wi-Fi is enabled and airplane mode is off. 2. Check whether other devices can connect to the same network. 3. Disconnect and reconnect to the approved network. 4. Do not share the Wi-Fi password here; contact IT if a work network still fails.
